# Prana Way

> Come back to yourself, gently.

Prana Way is one-to-one coaching in Bengaluru, India and online, led by Pratap,
an ICF-credentialed coach and NLP Practitioner.

## Who

- Coach: Pratap ({{TODO: full public name}})
- Credentials: ICF-credentialed coach (100+ coaching hours); NLP Practitioner
- Background: 10+ years in HR and people development (HRBP, L&D, people analytics,
  talent acquisition, organisational development); five years as Head of CX at Dunzo
  (scaled a team from 10 to ~1,000 with a focus on quality and training); currently
  AVP, Human Resources at a ~300-person digital agency in Bengaluru
- Location: Bengaluru, India; coaching is online {{TODO: confirm if in-person is offered}}

## What Prana Way offers

Calm, non-hustle coaching for five goals:
1. Get back to fitness (sleep, movement, energy)
2. Get rid of bad habits
3. Build resilience
4. Become the role model again (regain confidence)
5. Gain clarity and book your first coaching client

## Packages (INR, one-time)

- Single Focus — ₹30,000 · 3 weeks · one primary goal
- Steady Path — ₹50,000 · 6 weeks · two or three goals (most chosen)
- First Client — ₹30,000 · 4 weeks · for new coaches booking a first paid client

## Who it is for

Professionals and aspiring coaches who want steady change without hustle culture.
Not a substitute for therapy or clinical care.
